documentation.content: A production backend revision emitted a Firestore transaction lock-timeout or ABORTED error. Inspect route, concurrency, retry behavior, and 5xx telemetry. Preserve atomic quota, ownership, run, and deletion transactions.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND severity>=ERROR AND (textPayload:"Transaction lock timeout" OR textPayload:"10 ABORTED" OR jsonPayload.message:"Transaction lock timeout" OR jsonPayload.message:"10 ABORTED")
